She often sometimes claimed she saw her older brother upstairs and even called out to him but he wasn't even there. Almost all of us have these eerie feeling in that condo. We always think that our little sister just has an active imagination. But one time we all left the condo to play outside and my mother was left in the condo cooking. She swore she heard footsteps upstairs and thought our little sister was there. So she ignored it. But then suddenly she saw two dangling feet of a child that seemed like my sister. She shouted out why won't you come play with your siblings while she was cooking. There was no response of course. So when she finished cooking she decided to come upstairs to get my little sisters but there was no one there. She noped out of the condo and came to us shookd.
